public.title: Balanced Brackets
public.description: Given text made only of parentheses, square brackets and curly braces, return whether every closing bracket matches the most recent unmatched opening bracket of the same type. All brackets must be matched. The empty string is balanced. The input has at most 1000 characters.
hints: A stack records the opening brackets that still need a match.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Push opening brackets. Each closing bracket must match the stack top, which is then removed. Accept only if the stack is empty after the scan. Time and worst-case space are O(n).
